rounds: Students should choose their degree mainly for the job it leads to.
An unpaid internship is never worth doing.
Your first boss matters more than your first salary.
It’s fine to use AI to write your job applications.
Job interviews tell an employer almost nothing useful.
Working from home is bad for people at the start of their careers.
I expect to change career completely at least once.
Grades say very little about how good someone will be at a job.
